newsitem.title: USA: Kerr debtholders extend waiver on debt.
newsitem.headline: Kerr debtholders extend waiver on debt.

text.p: Kerr Group Inc said Wednesday that holders of $50.9 million of its unsecured debt extended a waiver of certain covenants and extended the maturity of a portion of the debt through January 25.
Kerr also said it would not pay a dividend on its Class B Series D preferred stock for the quarter ended December 31.
The debtholders proposed a restructuring to involve exchanging all of the debt for Kerr common stock.
Kerr said it expects to continue discussions with the holders regarding a possible restructuring, although there is no assurance that any agreement will be reached.
Kerr said the preferred stock dividend of $0.425 per share would continue to accumulate in accordance with the provisions of the stock.
